content.text: The verifier's narrative confirms the finding on every substantive point; the only outstanding item is a regex heuristic ("general-solicitation carve-out present") that cannot pass when the preferred position is the absence of any covenant. I will resubmit the finding unchanged in substance, with that noted.

input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position. The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-poach, no-hire or inducement covenant binding the Customer or either Party. Sweeps for the rule's detection terms — "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "poach", "hire", "employ", "employ or engage", "personnel", "staff" and "shall not" — return only: indemnity references to third parties "hired by, employed, retained or under" a Party's control (p0051, p0052); confidentiality handling by employees and directors (p0056, p0061); authorized-personnel data access controls (p0035, p0045); and the independent-contractor / no-agency clause quoted above (p0066), which imposes no solicitation, hiring or inducement restriction. Because the preferred position for this rule is the absence of any non-solicit on the Customer, the absence of such a clause is the best available outcome for us; no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and the text is left unchanged. The two deterministic checks (duration no greater than 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out present) fail by construction: both measure terms inside a restrictive covenant, and there is no covenant here to measure, so their failure is an artifact rather than evidence of a deviation. Internal negotiation guidance if the Vendor later introduces such a covenant: hold it to the fallback — mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire. A no-hire provision, a restriction longer than 24 months, or one covering all Vendor personnel is walk-away.
